evidence: The CaCO3 thin films were deposited using the Ca(thd)2–O3 process. Ca(thd)2 (Volatec Oy, Finland) was evaporated from an open source boat at 188 /C14 C and O3 was generated from O2 (99.9999%) with a Wedeco Ozomatic Modular 4 HC Lab ozone generator. Nitrogen was used as a carrier and purging gas.
